title: Ansible Galaxy repository settings
description: The ansible member of a repository document (R-REPO-004, R-ANS-019). A member lists the classes it applies to in x-trove-classes; a member of another class is refused as not applicable. Local and virtual repositories have no settings of the format.

authUrl.title: Token endpoint URL
authUrl.description: Remote repositories of a Galaxy-compatible hub behind single sign-on (R-ANS-019). The https URL (http only for a loopback address, which the service checks) of the token endpoint of the hub's identity realm, where the offline token stored in the repository's credential is exchanged for a short-lived access token. The repository needs authMode bearer, and the endpoint's host is the upstream's or an extraHosts entry with sendCredentials. Left out, the upstream is called with the credential as it is (a static token).

clientId.title: Client ID
clientId.description: Remote repositories with authUrl (R-ANS-019). The client id the exchange presents to the realm.

fetchDocumentation.title: Fetch documentation
fetchDocumentation.description: Remote repositories (R-ANS-035, R-ANS-042). Fetch the docs-blob document of a version from the upstream, by the job that follows the version document and by a client's request for the route, and keep the documentation it holds. With false the route answers 404 and no rows are written; a client that wants the document goes to the upstream.
